hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" session claude'
sh -c 'r=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" prompt claude'

sh -c 'r=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || { [ -f "$r/.agents/config.yaml" ] || exit 0; echo "proofline: $h is missing; failing closed" >&2; exit 2; }; exec sh "$h" pretool claude'
sh -c 'r=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" posttool claude'
sh -c 'r=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" subagent-start claude'
sh -c 'r=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" subagent-stop claude'
sh -c 'r=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; h=$r/.agents/hooks/proofline-hook.sh; [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$h" stop claude'
